intro.text: The First Company's medical vice president, who takes part in the talks with the Ones Above.

items.text: Waves handled the trade with the Ones Above for medicine, both to fight the plague among the Aviar and to treat people, which sharply cut the number of infants dying in the homeisles.

appearance.text: A squat man with a bright red Aviar that sharpens his sense of colour.
